description: This file defines the StepController class in the OrchardCore.Deployment.Controllers namespace, handling CRUD operations and order updates for deployment steps within deployment plans, with authorization and notification features.

classes.name: StepController
classes.description: Controller managing deployment steps within deployment plans, including creation, editing, deletion, and order updating, with authorization and notification support.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles GET request to initialize creation of a new deployment step, building the editor view.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create and save a new deployment step, validating and adding it to the deployment plan.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles GET request to load the edit view for a specific deployment step.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing deployment step, validating and saving changes.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a deployment step from the deployment plan.

methods.name: UpdateOrder
methods.description: Handles POST request to reorder deployment steps within a deployment plan.
